setupTasks.name: Build website
setupTasks.command: cd web && npm ci && npm run build

strategy-city.name: Strategy City (paper trading)
strategy-city.command: export STRATEGY_API_TOKEN="${STRATEGY_API_TOKEN:-$(.venv/bin/python -c 'import secrets; print(secrets.token_urlsafe(18))')}" && echo "Sign-in token for this session: $STRATEGY_API_TOKEN" && .venv/bin/python -m uvicorn backend.app:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --workers 1
